The Destination

Diego Suarez

Situated on the northernmost tip of Madagascar, Diego Suarez — officially known as Antsiranana — is one of the island's most captivating destinations. Renowned for its spectacular natural harbour, dramatic landscapes, rich cultural heritage and endless opportunities for adventure, Diego Suarez offers a unique blend of nature, history and outdoor exploration.

Framed by turquoise bays, rugged mountains and pristine coastline, the region is often referred to as Madagascar's adventure capital. From sailing across one of the world's largest natural bays to discovering hidden emerald lagoons and lush rainforests, Diego Suarez provides an unforgettable introduction to northern Madagascar.

Natural Beauty & Coastal Landscapes

A Landscape of Extraordinary Diversity

Diego Suarez is home to a remarkable diversity of landscapes unlike anywhere else in Madagascar. The vast Bay of Diego Suarez creates a stunning setting for sailing and watersports. Just offshore lies the famous Emerald Sea — a shallow lagoon of crystal-clear turquoise waters and white sandbanks. Inland, lush rainforests, waterfalls and volcanic crater lakes await within Amber Mountain National Park, while the striking Red Tsingy showcase Madagascar's extraordinary geological diversity.

Experiences

Things to Do in Diego Suarez

The Emerald Sea

One of Madagascar's most beautiful marine environments — shallow turquoise waters, sandbanks and coral reefs create an idyllic tropical escape accessible by boat.

Amber Mountain National Park

Waterfalls, crater lakes, endemic wildlife and lush rainforest trails in one of Madagascar's most accessible and biodiverse national parks.

The Red Tsingy

Extraordinary red sandstone formations sculpted into dramatic pinnacles and canyons — one of Madagascar's most striking geological landmarks.

Kitesurfing & Windsurfing

Reliable winds and calm bay waters make Diego Suarez one of the best kitesurfing destinations in the Indian Ocean.

Wildlife Encounters

Spot lemurs, chameleons, endemic birds and unique plant species throughout the region's protected areas, including Ankarana Special Reserve.

Hiking & Cultural Exploration

Mountain trails with panoramic bay views, and a city shaped by a fascinating blend of Malagasy, African and French influences.

Accommodation

Where to Stay

Diego Suarez offers boutique lodges and beachfront retreats to luxury hotels — an ideal base for exploring northern Madagascar with easy access to the area's most celebrated natural attractions.

✦Boutique hotels overlooking the bay and coastline
✦Luxury eco-lodges surrounded by nature
✦Beachfront accommodation with direct ocean access
✦Personalised guided excursions and wildlife experiences
✦Kiting, diving and adventure activities on your doorstep
✦Authentic cultural encounters and locally inspired cuisine

When to Visit

May – November
Dry season. Best conditions for outdoor activities and wildlife watching.
June – September
Kitesurfing peak season — consistent strong winds.
Year-Round
Amber Mountain National Park is accessible year-round.
